user.title: Connect to your Kalfire Gi
user.description: We searched the local network for fireplaces. A discovered address is prefilled; if several were found, choose one. You can also enter an IP address or hostname manually, including when none were found. Setup only reads data. Make sure the fireplace is on the same subnet as Home Assistant.

pair.title: Open the pairing window
pair.description: Keep the official remote control that is paired with the fireplace near the fireplace. Hold the right round button directly above the M3 button for 3 seconds, then select the Submit button below.

existing_token.title: Existing local device token
existing_token.description: Enter a previously paired 24-character local token. This is not your cloud account password. The token stays in Home Assistant. No token? Leave the field empty and select Submit to return to the pairing choices.

reconfigure.title: Update the device address
reconfigure.description: The existing certificate pin and device identity must still match. A changed certificate is not accepted automatically.

subnet.title: Check the network
subnet.description: The address {host} is outside the subnets of Home Assistant’s enabled network interfaces. Make sure the fireplace is on the same subnet as Home Assistant. You can change the address or try connecting anyway if your network routes traffic between subnets. Hostnames cannot be checked this way.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, without a URL scheme or path.
error.cannot_connect: Could not communicate with the local fireplace. Check its address and UDP port 5684. Make sure the fireplace is on the same subnet as Home Assistant.
error.certificate_changed: Certificate changed. Check the device before removing and adding this integration to explicitly trust the new certificate.
error.pairing_failed: The token was rejected. Open the physical pairing window with the remote and try Submit again.
error.invalid_auth: The local token was rejected. Pair using the remote control.

abort.wrong_device: The address belongs to a different fireplace.

init.title: Kalfire Gi options
init.description: Enable the on/off switch and level controls only for deliberate use. Flame height and Sparks require a running fireplace without a reported fault. Ember Glow is always available independently of this option, including with the gas burner off. Enable Sparks only if the optional generator is installed. Ignite only while someone is present. Lost commands are never automatically retried.

data.enable_control: Enable on/off, flame-height and Sparks controls
